narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Four eighths is more, because eight is a bigger number than seven.
<bookmark mark='pieces'/>Lay one eighth beside one seventh of the same chikki. The eighth is the smaller piece.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A bigger bottom number means smaller pieces, so it cannot make the share bigger.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>The same number of chikkis shared among fewer children gives each child a bigger share.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Three chikkis among five children, or one chikki between two. Which share is more?
